_meta.purpose: Hand-curated historical director predictions, grounded in actual past earnings calls and what happened afterward. Loaded by scripts/seed_mongo.py at deploy time into the track_records collection.
_meta.outcome_window: Stock price change at +7 calendar days from earnings call, dividend-adjusted, compared to S&P 500 over the same window. Hit = director's directional prediction (bullish/bearish/neutral) matched the relative move within ±150bp.

records.evidence_quote: We expect notably lower vehicle volume growth rate in 2024 as we work toward the next-generation vehicle in Austin and Texas.
